The intent of this RFSQ is to prequalify experienced professional consulting architecture, landscape architecture, planning, engineering, construction management, or specialty firms (hereinafter the Consultant) to provide task-order or full-service assistance on various projects based upon the needs of the City of Columbus Recreation and Parks Department (CRPD). This prequalification process is being conducted in accordance with Columbus City Code, Title 3, Section 329.26-27.
